name: V1RUS
source:
After losing his best friend, Kryoz returns to the one place he's avoided – SMii7Y's computer.
But what he finds isn't closure – it's a voice that remembers, a program that evolves, and a presence that never really left.

[From [url=https://kittycat-427.itch.io/v1rus-a-frouse-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
失去最好的朋友后，Kryoz回到了他一直回避的地方——SMii7Y的电脑。
但他发现的并不是终结——而是一个可以记住的声音、一个不断发展的程序以及一个从未真正离开过的存在。

[来自[url=https://kittycat-427.itch.io/v1rus-a-frouse-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
